Name: Melon Madness
Overview:
A small 2D stadium with a quick gravitational hiccup to get things moving in a new way, a few over eager players to kick a ball about and you are playing 'Melon Madness'.

In 'Tournament' mode, take on the rookies and work your way to the pros for a challenge that only fools and heroes would rise to.

In 'Exhibition' mode, invite a friend for co-op or VS gameplay with up to 4 players (2 Vs 2).
